parsed.rationale: The second participating record, `MockNotificationMessage` in `Shared/Core/Sources/CoreTesting/_Plant_MockNotificationMessage.swift`, carries `is_test: true`. Per the decision rules, any cluster where at least one record is test-marked must be treated as a test-fixture and no refactor action taken. The `MockNotificationMessage` interface is a deliberate test double mirroring `AsyncNotificationMessage`; the single differing slot (`sending Notification` vs `Notification` in `makeMessage`) further confirms it is a purposefully adapted fixture rather than an accidental duplicate. Merging or lifting these two protocols would couple production semantics in `Core/Observation/AsyncMessage.swift` to test infrastructure in `CoreTesting`.
